name: Pulse du Reseau
description: Extension vivante de l'Omni-Réseau, Pulse du Reseau rythme sur la fréquence du réseau, maîtrise l'élément Réseau, vitesse de traitement ↑5, interfaces neurales directes. Lié au réseau par des fibres optiques invisibles, il anticipe les mouvements ennemis via la latence zéro.

subject.archetype: Quantum Relay Combat Specialist - Cyborg Infantry with Neural Network Interface

loadout.armor_outfit: Mass-produced composite tactical exoskeleton in anthracite gray with brushed steel plating over faded military utility suit. Prominent quantum relay module protruding from upper back with cooling fins. Neural cables running from cervical implant down spine to weapon system. Serial identification codes etched into forearm plating. Exposed pale cadaveric skin at neck junction showing brutal cable insertions.
loadout.arsenal: Integrated nullification beam emitter powered by direct neural connection. Both palms equipped with focusing crystal arrays. Weapon system connected via thick black cables to wrist implants and spinal relay module. Shoulder-mounted signal booster array.

attitude.behavior: Fully committed combat stance with both hands thrust forward in pushing motion. Body aligned with weapon trajectory. Legs braced in wide stance for recoil absorption. Entire body connected to weapon system through visible neural cables pulsing with icy blue energy. Movement frozen at moment of maximum energy discharge.
attitude.emotion: Inexpressive face with dead eyes reflecting holographic glitches. Complete emotional nullification typical of Omni-Réseau operatives. Intense cybernetic focus visible through flickering optic implants. Mind fully synchronized with quantum relay targeting system.

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with cold blue accent lights on neural implants and weapon charge. Harsh industrial overhead lighting creating deep shadows on armor edges. Volumetric light cutting through particle effects from electric storms. Weapon discharge creating intense forward light bloom.
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, industrial, technologically oppressive with undertones of cold calculated violence

camera.angle: Dutch angle dynamic low perspective looking up at combatant to emphasize power and threat. Slight tilt to enhance combat tension. Close-up framing focused on upper body and weapon discharge with crumbling server environment in background.

scenography.setting: Collapsed cyber warfare zone with massive toppling server towers in background sparking and short-circuiting. Holographic command displays shattering into fragments mid-air. Digital fortification barriers crumbling into pixelated debris. Quantum relay infrastructure torn apart with visible deteriorating code streaming like digital blood. Debris field of destroyed drones and severed neural cables. Cracked technological floor plating with exposed power conduits arcing.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Electric storms rippling through collapsing infrastructure creating lightning-like energy discharges. Blue-white holographic glitch effects distorting reality around the combatant. Particle systems of sparks, shattered data fragments, and burning circuit debris. Volumetric fog of ionized air from weapon discharge. Ice blue energy shield fragments dissolving in air. Acid rain residue creating reflections on armor surfaces.
